empty_hint:
No Windows PCs added yet.
Tap "+ Add PC" above and enter your LAN IP & username.
err_invalid_endpoint: Enter a valid IP address and port.
err_invalid_user: Enter a valid username (6-64 chars) and password.
err_admission_pending: Host is starting or cleaning up another session. Please try again shortly.
err_admission_busy: Host is currently in use; this device must first be approved while idle.
err_admission_rate_limited: Too many connection attempts. Please try again later.
err_session_replaced: Session was taken over by another device.
err_timeout_approval: Timed out waiting for host approval. Check the prompt on Windows and try again.
status_connecting_tls: Establishing TLS connection and waiting for host approval…
status_step_approval: Waiting for local host approval; on first connection, allow this device on Windows.
status_step_channels: Setting up display and auxiliary channels…
takeover_msg: Continuing will disconnect the current viewer. Take over this PC?
text_hint: Enter text to send to Windows
cert_msg: First connection or host certificate changed. Verify the SHA-256 fingerprint shown on Windows:
enc_unavail_msg: Android Keystore encryption is unavailable on this device. Save password in plaintext or connect without saving?
video_tip: Automatic mode adjusts within these limits using RTT and drops. Targets do not guarantee delivered frame rate or bandwidth.
probe_intro: First-frame probe only. Independently verify the certificate fingerprint on the host.
probe_perm_granted: LAN permission granted. Re-enter password and tap Connect.
probe_err_endpoint: Enter LAN IP, port, and verified SHA-256 fingerprint.
probe_connecting: Connecting. Approve on Windows if prompted.
probe_timeout: Connection or first frame timed out. Disconnected.
probe_auth_failed: Authentication failed. Check host status and certificate fingerprint.
display_pixels_tip: One video pixel per display pixel; downsampled video is not host-native resolution.
